description: This file defines an enum 'SessionKey' with static methods for generating and checking session key strings, used for managing session identifiers in the application.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a main session key, defaulting to 'main' if input is empty or null.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for an agent, combining agentId and baseKey after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is the canonical 'global' or an 'agent' session key.
